newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Looters set hotel ablaze in southern Albania.
newsitem.headline: Looters set hotel ablaze in southern Albania.

text.p: Looters ransacked an eight-storey hotel in the rebel-held Albanian coastal town of Sarande on Tuesday and set the building ablaze, witnesses said.
They said the looters carried out furniture, silverware, toilet seats, doors and lamps before setting fire to the hotel in central Sarande.

Rebels opposing President Sali Berisha took control of Sarande, just across from the Greek holiday island of Corfu, last week A rebel council in the town said looters would be punished but people drove up to the hotel throughout the day, loading up cars and trucks before driving off.
